purpose: C-to-S coverage mapping (Astra R5-08): the C0-C6 package slices and the migrated controller state use different slice vocabularies. This maps them by ACTUAL FILE CONTENT so a reader can tell which controller slice carries which package slice's work, and where the correspondence is genuinely not 1:1.
controllerVocabulary: S83-SELECTION-AND-PRESERVED-BASELINE, S84, S85, S86, S87, S88a, S88b, S89, S90 (workflow-state-v8.json)
method: Classified each S slice's allowedFiles by path area (harness, persistence-suites, migration, coach-assistant FE, browser, config) and matched against the C slices' declared scope. Every mapping below cites the file evidence that justifies it. Where a slice spans more than one C concern, that is stated rather than forced into a single row.

mapping.status: NOT COVERED BY THE CONTROLLER STATE
mapping.evidence: The controller has no slice whose allowedFiles include scripts/coach-completion-checkpoint.mjs or PKG/evidence/*. C0 is package-admission work that predates the C-vocabulary.
mapping.consequence: C0's own work is tracked by PKG/evidence/, not by a controller slice. This is a REAL gap in the binding, not a naming difference. v8's index 0 sits on S83-SELECTION-AND-PRESERVED-BASELINE, which is not C0.
mapping.needs: Either a C0 slice appended to the controller, or an explicit statement that C0 is governed outside the controller.

mapping.evidence: S84's allowedFiles include backend/tests/integration/coachMemoryPersistence.postgres.test.mjs and the coachFact* services — the memory persistence surface C1 requires. S85's include backend/tests/integration/coachConsentPersistence.postgres.test.mjs, backend/services/notificationPreferenceUpdateService.mjs and both writers — the consent surface C1 requires.
mapping.note: C1 also requires the RUNNER changes (coachRunnerLifecycle.mjs, run-coach-postgres.mjs). Those appear in NEITHER S slice's allowedFiles.
mapping.uncoveredWithinC1: The runner hardening (R4-03/R5-01/R5-02) has no controller slice. This is the work most recently completed and it is currently bound by no controller scope.

mapping.evidence: S84 holds backend/migrations/20260913010000-add-coach-fact-correction-replay.cjs and backend/tests/unit/coachFactsMigration.test.mjs. C2 additionally requires the migration-completion suite, its config and fixtures, which do not exist yet and so appear in no allowedFiles.
mapping.note: Correct for not-yet-created files: a future deliverable cannot be in a scope that was frozen before it existed.

mapping.evidence: S86 is 14 coach-assistant FE files; S87 is 9 coach-assistant FE files plus 6 other and 1 browser. C3's scope is the created-thread composition and navigation lifecycle in the coach-assistant tree.
mapping.note: S87 carries a browser file, so it straddles C3 and C4.

mapping.evidence: S88b holds 2 browser files; S87 and S89 hold 1 each. C4's scope is the mounted completion journeys.
mapping.note: The C4 browser configs (playwright.coach-completion.config.ts, the two new real specs) do not exist yet and appear in no allowedFiles.

mapping.status: NOT COVERED BY THE CONTROLLER STATE
mapping.evidence: No S slice's allowedFiles include PKG/evidence/module-line-audit.json, verification-receipt.json, or the swan-coach-universe-v3 findings register.
mapping.consequence: Same shape as C0: evidence-closure work tracked by PKG/evidence/ rather than a controller slice.

mapping.status: NOT COVERED BY THE CONTROLLER STATE
mapping.evidence: The controller's FINAL stage is separate from its slice list; no S slice covers the combined Astra adjudication.
mapping.note: In the controller's model, C6 would be the FINAL stage, not a slice. That is a vocabulary difference rather than a gap — but it is UNCONFIRMED because no FINAL slice has been configured in v8.

summary.honestStatement: The mapping is NOT clean. C3 maps well; C1/C2/C4 map with splits and overlaps; C0 and C5 are tracked by PKG/evidence/ rather than by any controller slice; C6 is probably the FINAL stage but is unconfirmed. The most consequential finding is that the RUNNER HARDENING — the R4-03/R5-01/R5-02 work — falls inside C1's requirement yet inside NO controller slice's scope.
summary.runnerScopeGap: CONFIRMED AND HISTORICAL: all 6 guarded-runner files have NO controller owner in v8, AND had none in v4, v5, v6 or v7. See evidence/r5-08-scope-finding.md. C1 acceptance criteria reference these files; C1 scope does not contain them. preserveOwnedScope never fired because there was nothing to lose.

unresolved: Whether C0 and C5 should be appended as controller slices, or explicitly governed outside the controller.
Whether C6 should be the controller's FINAL stage.
notDone: No controller change is made by this document. It reports the mapping and its gaps; resolving them is a scoping decision.

resolved.item: Which controller slice, if any, is permitted to touch the runner files (run-coach-postgres.mjs, coachRunnerLifecycle.mjs, coachRunnerReport.mjs, coachRunnerVerdict.mjs).
RESOLVE THE RUNNER SCOPE GAP: append a bounded slice covering the runner surface, or declare it explicitly out of controller scope and name its governing authority.
resolved.resolution: Option (a) taken: a bounded slice was appended. S91 owns 11 paths, including the 6 named in the finding and the 5 same-surface paths the finding did not name.
resolved.newFinding: checkControllerMigration is blind to a slice's allowedFiles being hollowed to []. Recorded in the closure doc; NOT fixed this cycle.
